name: Maty Bohacek
description: Researcher at Stanford University interested in AI's impact on media, discourse, and communication integrity.
bio: I am a student researcher at Stanford University advised by Prof. Maneesh Agrawala. I work at the intersection of AI, computer vision, and media forensics. In a world that is becoming increasingly AI-mediated, my goal is to build AI systems and that are inherently trustworthy and interpretable, resulting in productive, democratic discourse.
